HowItWorks.title: How It Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps between where you are now and your new home in Canada.

step1.title: Tell Us What You Need
step1.description: Choose your city, budget, apartment size and move-in date.

step2.title: Discover Available Apartments
step2.description: Browse available homes from our partner properties.

step3.title: Speak With an Advisor
step3.description: Our team helps you compare options and guides you through the rental process.

step4.title: Secure Your New Home
step4.description: Complete the required rental application and prepare for your move to Canada.

HowItWorks.disclaimer: Rental applications remain subject to the applicable property owner or manager's approval criteria.

Trust.title: Moving countries is stressful. Finding your home shouldn't be.

verified.title: Verified Rental Properties
verified.description: We work directly with rental buildings, property managers, and developers.

advisors.title: Real Housing Advisors
advisors.description: A person — not a bot — helps you compare options and answers your questions.

pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: No hidden fees. What you see is what you're working with.

local.title: Local Knowledge
local.description: We know the neighbourhoods, the commutes, and what matters when you're moving from abroad.

beforeArrival.title: Support Before You Arrive
beforeArrival.description: Start the process from anywhere in the world, before you land in Canada.

languages.title: Support in Multiple Languages
languages.description: We communicate in the language you're most comfortable with.
